changes: No substantive changes. I kept VS for 'saṃvat 1908' because NS 1908 is impossible and ŚS 1908 would be 1986 CE. ce_approx is 1851 (the year may run into 1852).
Added a note that the catalogue title (Tarkasaṃgrahagūḍhārtha) differs from the colophon title (Siddhāntacandra, a tarkasaṃgrahavivaraṇa).

notes: The colophon gives only 'saṃvat 1908' with no era name. I take it as Vikrama because it is the only plausible reading: NS 1908 is impossible and ŚS 1908 would be 1986 CE. The catalogue records 'King: Rāja Siṃha', but no king appears in the quoted colophon, so this person is not included. 'Siddhāntacandra' is the title of the commentary (tarkasaṃgrahavivaraṇa), not a person. The catalogue title 'Tarkasaṃgrahagūḍhārtha' differs from the title in the colophon.
